pipeline.title: Synology DSM (category + connection + AFP)
pipeline.description: Extract nas_category from the DSM BSD-syslog prefix, then a second stage with per-category parsers for the high-value ones: Connection (user/IP/auth result) and MacFileService Event (AFP op/path/size). Other categories fall through with just the category set. Connect to the 'NAS' stream.

rules.title: nas extract category
rules.description: DSM BSD-syslog body is 'nas <Category>: <details>'. Pulls the category (Connection, System, MacFileService Event, SMB, WebDAV, FTP, AFP, TFTP, Backup, Network Backup, File Station Event, etc.) into nas_category for slicing.

rules.title: nas connection event extract
rules.description: Connection lines look like 'User [<user>] from [<ip>] signed in to [<target>] successfully via [<method>].' Pulls user / client_ip / action / target / result / auth_method.

rules.title: nas afp event extract
rules.description: MacFileService Event lines look like '<OP>, Path: <path>, File/Folder: <kind>, Size: <n> <unit>, User: <user>, IP: <ip>'. Pulls op / path / file_kind / size_bytes / user / client_ip.
